Usage: featherless-cloud [options] [command]

Featherless GPU Cloud CLI

Options:
  --json                       output as JSON (for scripts and agents)
  --non-interactive            disable spinners and prompts
  -V, --version                output the version number
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]              Store an API key for this device
  logout [options]             Remove stored credentials for a profile
  instance                     Manage GPU instances
  volume                       Manage network storage volumes
  pricing                      Browse compute and storage prices
  gpu                          List the GPU models you can run on
  billing                      Show balance and usage history
  runjob|job                   Run and manage Run Jobs
  exec [options] [command...]  Run a command on temporary CPU or GPU compute
  ssh-keys                     Manage your SSH public keys
  registry-keys                Manage container registry logins for private
                               images
  templates                    Save launch settings and launch instances and Run
                               Jobs from them
  init [options]               Write .featherless-cloud.toml with this project's
                               defaults
  upgrade [options]            Upgrade featherless-cloud to the latest published
                               version
  completion <shell>           Print a shell completion script (bash, zsh)
  help [command]               display help for command

Usage: featherless-cloud instance create [options]

Create an instance

Options:
  --name <name>                 instance name (random when omitted)
  --template <name>             template to launch: a name, org/<name>,
                                featherless/<name> or an id; other flags
                                override it
  --template-id <id>            template to launch, by id
  --template-version <version>  an official template's version, e.g. 2.11.0 (or
                                --template name:version); its current one by
                                default
  --image <reference>           container image to run, or to replace the
                                template's
  --registry <name|id>          registry credential for a private image
  --compute-type <type>         gpu or cpu (choices: "gpu", "cpu", default:
                                "gpu")
  --gpu-type <text>             GPU model substring, e.g. mi325x
  --gpu-count <n>               GPUs per instance: 1, 2, 4, or 8
  --cpu-cores <n>               vCPU cores for --compute-type cpu
  --disk <gb>                   container disk in GB (20-2000) (default: "20")
  --volume <name:path>          mount a network volume, repeatable (default: [])
  --command <string>            override the start command (whitespace-split, no
                                shell quoting)
  --env <K=V>                   environment variable, repeatable (default: [])
  --secret <K=V>                secret variable, repeatable (default: [])
  --port <port>                 serve this port at a public HTTPS address,
                                repeatable (default: [])
  --profile <name>              profile to use
  --config-file <path>          project defaults file (default:
                                .featherless-cloud.toml in this folder or a
                                parent)
  --no-config-file              ignore .featherless-cloud.toml
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Global Options:
  --json                        output as JSON (for scripts and agents)
  --non-interactive             disable spinners and prompts
  -V, --version                 output the version number

Creation is retry-safe: re-running the same command within the
idempotency window returns the original instance.

Usage: featherless-cloud instance ssh [options] <id>

Open a shell using your local OpenSSH client

Arguments:
  id                     instance name or short id

Options:
  -i, --identity <file>  SSH private key file (otherwise use SSH config/agent)
  --profile <name>       profile to use
  -h, --help             display help for command

Global Options:
  --json                 output as JSON (for scripts and agents)
  --non-interactive      disable spinners and prompts
  -V, --version          output the version number

Uses native SSH config, agent and host-key checks. Register your public key in the console first.
Exit with exit, or Enter then ~. (the normal SSH escape).

Usage: featherless-cloud instance tmux [options] <id> [name]

Create or attach an exact named tmux session over SSH (default: default, the
session the browser terminal opens)

Arguments:
  id                     instance name or short id
  name                   tmux session name

Options:
  -i, --identity <file>  SSH private key file (otherwise use SSH config/agent)
  --profile <name>       profile to use
  -h, --help             display help for command

Global Options:
  --json                 output as JSON (for scripts and agents)
  --non-interactive      disable spinners and prompts
  -V, --version          output the version number

Names: 1–64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; start with a letter or digit.
Uses tmux on the default socket for the SSH login user; tmux must already be installed.
Detach with Ctrl-b d; reconnect with the same name. Enter then ~. disconnects SSH.
Sessions survive disconnects, not instance stop/restart/replacement or tmux server exit.
No software is installed and no SSH keys are registered automatically.

Usage: featherless-cloud volume find [options] <path>

Find files and folders below a folder in a volume (vol://<volume>/<path>),
printing each as it is found

Arguments:
  path                  vol://<volume>/<path> folder to search

Options:
  --name <pattern>      names matching a pattern like "*.safetensors": * matches
                        any characters, ? one, [abc] one of those
  --iname <pattern>     like --name, ignoring case
  --type <f|d>          only files (f) or only folders (d) (choices: "f", "d")
  --maxdepth <n>        how many levels below the folder to look
  --size <+n|-n>        more (+) or less (-) than a size like 10G or 512K;
                        repeat for a range
  --newer-than <age>    modified within an age like 30m, 12h or 7d
  --older-than <age>    modified longer ago than an age like 30m, 12h or 7d
  -l, --long            print each with its modification time and size, like ls
  -h, --human-readable  with -l, sizes like 1.5 KiB and 100.0 MiB instead of
                        bytes
  -0, --print0          end each with a NUL instead of a newline, for xargs -0
  --profile <name>      profile to use
  --help                display help for command

Global Options:
  --json                output as JSON (for scripts and agents)
  --non-interactive     disable spinners and prompts
  -V, --version         output the version number

Usage: featherless-cloud volume cp [options] <sources...> <destination>

Copy files or folders between this computer and a volume, or between volumes;
interrupted copies resume when run again

Arguments:
  paths              sources, then the destination: local or vol:// paths

Options:
  -r, --recursive    copy folders and everything in them
  --overwrite        replace files that already exist at the destination
  --update           skip files whose size and modification time already match
  --concurrency <n>  files at a time, 1 to 32 (default: "16")
  --dry-run          show what would be copied
  -v, --verbose      print each file as it is copied
  --progress         show a running total on stderr
  --profile <name>   profile to use
  -h, --help         display help for command

Global Options:
  --json             output as JSON (for scripts and agents)
  --non-interactive  disable spinners and prompts
  -V, --version      output the version number

Examples:
  featherless-cloud volume cp -r ./weights vol://datasets/models/
  featherless-cloud volume cp vol://datasets/models/out.bin .
  featherless-cloud volume cp -r vol://datasets/models vol://checkpoints/

Usage: featherless-cloud volume sync [options] <local-folder> <vol://<volume>/<path>

Sync a folder with a folder in a volume, sending what changed each way; never
deletes

Arguments:
  local-folder       folder on this computer
  remote-folder      vol://<volume>/<path> folder in the volume

Options:
  --mode <mode>      upload, download or both (default: "both")
  --dry-run          show what would be sent, received and created
  --mkdirs           create missing folders on either side
  --force            send even when the chosen side is older (needs --mode
                     upload or --mode download)
  --concurrency <n>  files at a time, 1 to 32 (default: "16")
  --include <glob>   only relative paths matching a glob (*, ** and ?) (default:
                     [])
  --exclude <glob>   skip relative paths matching a glob (*, ** and ?) (default:
                     [])
  -v, --verbose      print each file as it syncs
  --progress         show a running total on stderr
  --profile <name>   profile to use
  -h, --help         display help for command

Global Options:
  --json             output as JSON (for scripts and agents)
  --non-interactive  disable spinners and prompts
  -V, --version      output the version number

Examples:
  featherless-cloud volume sync ./weights vol://datasets/models/
  featherless-cloud volume sync --mode download --mkdirs . vol://datasets/models
  featherless-cloud volume sync --dry-run ./ckpt vol://datasets/ckpt

Usage: featherless-cloud exec [options] [command...]

Run a command on temporary CPU or GPU compute

Options:
  --name <name>                 Run Job name (random when omitted)
  --template <name>             template: a name, org/<name>, featherless/<name>
                                or an id; defaults to the PyTorch environment
  --template-id <id>            template, by id
  --template-version <version>  an official template's version, e.g. 2.11.0 (or
                                --template name:version); its current one by
                                default
  --image <reference>           container image to run, or to replace the
                                template's
  --registry <name|id>          registry credential for a private image
  --gpu-type <text>             GPU model substring, e.g. mi325x
  --gpu-count <n>               GPUs: 1, 2, 4, or 8
  --cpu-cores <n>               vCPU cores; mutually exclusive with GPU options
  --disk <gb>                   container disk in GB (20-2000) (default: "20")
  --volume <name:path>          mount a network volume, repeatable (default: [])
  --workdir <path>              container working directory (default:
                                "/workspace")
  --env <K=V>                   environment variable, repeatable (default: [])
  --secret <K=V>                secret variable, repeatable (default: [])
  --timeout <seconds>           run time limit after compute assignment
                                (1-86400) (default: "86400")
  --preemption-retries <n>      start again from the beginning up to n times if
                                interrupted for other work (0-3) (default: "0")
  --no-retain-logs              disable output collection, including live
                                attached output
  --idempotency-key <key>       retry-safe execution key (random when omitted)
  --detach                      submit without waiting for the result
  --cancel-on-interrupt         cancel instead of detach when Ctrl-C is pressed
  --profile <name>              authentication profile to use
  --config-file <path>          project defaults file (default:
                                .featherless-cloud.toml in this folder or a
                                parent)
  --no-config-file              ignore .featherless-cloud.toml
